name: LegoLux
author: Setting_Sun
description:
LegoLux is a short game, featuring a unique atmosphere, both fast-paced and thought provoking level design and challenges, and a narrative, presented through cutscenes and gameplay that span across three varied levels. Please enjoy this game I've made using the included Lego Behavior scripts and my own custom scripts. Although I only worked on this for a few weeks, it was a fun and interesting challenge. Music: "Gloom" by Jahzzar, via Free Music Archive, CC BY-SA 4.0.

Dedicated to my cat Abbey.
